what_this_is: The documented verification chain run in a fresh clone of the pushed public branch, on the configuration that broke it before: Windows, core.autocrlf=true, no local state. Four pages, two documents, five gates.
what_this_record_cannot_show: It shows the gate chain reproduces from the pushed bytes. It cannot show that HotCRP serves those bytes -- that is a separate comparison against the PDF the site returns, and it is recorded in the operations log, not here.
why_the_record_lags_head_by_one_commit: This file is tracked, so the commit it describes cannot also contain it. The gate closes the gap from the other side: it requires cloned_head to be an ancestor of HEAD and requires pin_at_clone to equal the BUILD_PIN.json blob at cloned_head, so a record cannot claim a newer tree than the one it measured.
